Hi Sophie — great to meet you over email and thanks for the sample. I looped in Neha (solutions) and Rishi (pricing) to give a crisp answer. Quick summary while they add details below: 

- Baseline: we price embeddings primarily per-vector for hosted API usage; there are also per-token charges only for on-the-fly text preprocessing in some workflows. Dimensionality influences compute cost and therefore the list price — higher dims => higher baseline per-vector price.
- Models: for most semantic search pilots we recommend our 1536-d embeddings for best recall; 512/768 are good for lower-cost similarity setups. Model choice affects price and latency.
- Discounts: we provide tiered volume discounts and bespoke committed-rate contracts for enterprise pilots (12/24 month commits).
- Storage: vector storage is billed separately by most partners / infra; Redwood can provide guidance and integrations — storage costs are not part of the per-vector generation price unless you ask for managed storage add-ons.

Neha / Rishi — could you take the sample and propose: (1) a straightforward per-vector rate table for 512/768/1536 dims for hosted API, (2) a starter packaging option for a 3-month pilot (25M vectors/month target) and (3) an enterprise committed option for 12 months at 50M vectors/month?

I'll follow up with availability for a 30-min sync.

— Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Hi Sophie — thanks for the sample and context. I ran a quick embed pass with our lightweight encoder and Rishi helped model the economics. Below is a pragmatic set of baseline rates we can offer on the hosted API: 

Baseline (list) per-vector rates — hosted API
- 512-dim: $0.00040 per vector
- 768-dim: $0.00060 per vector
- 1536-dim: $0.00120 per vector

Notes:
- These are generation costs only (embedding creation). They do not include separate managed vector storage or retrieval costs (we can provide partner options).
- Short text tokenization overhead is negligible for typical title-length inputs; for very long documents we quote a small per-token preprocessing fee (estimate: $0.000005 per input token) — we can opt to roll this into the per-vector price for an agreed pilot.

Packaging suggestions for Atlas pilot (25M vectors / month target)
- Pilot pack (3 months): 25M vectors / month commitment. Pricing: list rates above with a 15% pilot discount applied across dims. Includes 2 support sessions, one onboarding eval, and rate-lock for the pilot period.

Enterprise committed option (12 months, 50M vectors / month)
- Committed discount: starting at 25% off list, sliding to 30% for multi-year or added managed storage purchase. Includes SSO, audit logs, and 99.9% SLA.
- We can provide a capped overage rate instead of immediate throttle if helpful.

If these numbers look reasonable, Rishi can draft a committed-rate term sheet and I can schedule a pilot onboarding session.

Cheers,
Neha Kapoor
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
